description: Runtime configuration for the Privileged App Path Auditor. These settings control thresholds, exclusions, and behavior. Override values here to customize for your environment.

stalePrivilege.description: Number of days without a sign-in before an app is considered stale

filters.description: Filter settings. excludeFirstPartyMicrosoftApps uses the merill/microsoft-info database (4000+ known app IDs, refreshed daily) plus appOwnerOrganizationId to identify and skip Microsoft first-party apps.

consentRisk.description: When true, ConsentRisk mode enumerates single-user delegated permission grants. The principal is the beneficiary; the grant does not identify who approved consent.

credentialHygiene.description: Credential type names match report values. Any currently valid direct SP credential triggers the special critical classification because it is stored separately from the app-registration credential view. Future and expired credentials remain inventory and can still trigger configured hygiene rules.

output.description: Controls output size. Users beyond truncateAfter are summarized as '... (N more)' in console output. Full data is always included in CSV exports.
